request_without_reference_paths.prompt: Create ONE original standalone asset for the SAME knowledge-city strategy-game civilization as the supplied Memory Archive image. Use the image as a strict material and architectural craftsmanship reference, NOT as a silhouette to copy. Warm pale limestone, broad dark slate ceramic roof elements where appropriate, aged copper structural accents, elegant stepped foundations and restrained luminous details. Large calm material regions, warm handcrafted stylized finish, sophisticated proportions rather than medieval fantasy or photorealism. Connection Gateway: two broad substantial pale stone pylons supporting a LOW wide copper-edged slate lintel, framing ONE clear open passage. Make a refined inhabited architectural gateway, not a triumphal arch, castle gate or science-fiction portal. Wide grounded stepped plinth, shallow rectangular service panels on the pylons, a single subtle turquoise glass strip recessed in the lintel. A bold simple portal silhouette, width dominates height. No doors blocking the passage, no spires, towers, defenses, energy effects, chains, thin bars or additional buildings. The passage is intentional negative space; the lintel must be thick and structurally connected. Show the complete standalone subject in one clearly ELEVATED THREE-QUARTER ISOMETRIC view, with both front and side visible, all edges inside frame, neutral background and transparent cutout. Readable at small strategy-map scale. All walls and roofs closed except the explicitly intended architectural passage or open plaza. Windows only simple shallow framed recessed panels, never perforations. Thick connected structural pieces, no thin railings or filigree, no text, logos, people, dramatic baked shadows, excessive grime, floating pieces or surrounding scenery.

request.text_style_prompt: Original knowledge-city connection gateway. Two massive warm pale limestone pylons with shallow recessed stone panels, a stepped limestone base and a clear pale passage floor. Long dark slate ceramic hipped roof with aged copper ridge and edge trim. Small aged copper inset panels and eave brackets with restrained verdigris. Exactly one contained turquoise glass strip set in the recessed lintel band above the opening; turquoise never on the roof, pylons or floor. Broad calm hand-crafted stylized material regions readable from an elevated strategy-game camera, subtle stone variation, restrained weathering. Preserve the geometry. No text, logos, grime, baked lighting or baked shadows. Limestone matte, slate moderately rough, copper metallic.
